2027 RX is sharpening its style with optional red front and rear brake calipers on the F SPORT Handling and Performance grades. The 2027 Lexus RX is available in six grades: Premium, Premium+, Luxury, F SPORT Handling, F SPORT Performance, and F SPORT Design. Depending on the grade, it is offered in exterior color options including Cloudburst Gray, Iridium, Caviar, Matador Red Mica, Nori Green Pearl, Nightfall Mica, Ultra White and Incognito.
